name: AppRankly
description: Mobile app analytics and ASO dashboard for Google Play and the App Store.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The config (config/config.json and your store keys in config/keys/), cached stats, notes, the admin password hash and the JWT secret AppRankly makes on first start.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: AppRankly dashboard, published on host as 6723

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: The port AppRankly listens on inside the container. Leave it as 3000.

variables.name: DATA_DIR
variables.description: Where AppRankly keeps its data inside the container. Leave it as /app/data.

variables.name: CONFIG_PATH
variables.description: The config file inside the container. Leave it as /app/data/config/config.json.
